failedAnchorPolicy: 51 remains the prior registration failure; no replacement or rerun
history: Old same-cohort consecutive OLS over up to 51 observations ending at anchor; cv_1s uses up to the last26 of exactly this history; complete-history scored agents have exactly51/26 points
pressureLaw: Current Stage1 hook with own normalized occupancy subtracted per receiver at every node before applying unchanged rho0 and stiffness; total grid density remains descriptive. Zero pressure correction leaves velocity unchanged.
speedCapOrder: Both agent arms retain legacy pair/preferred update and common speed cap. Corrected Stage1 skips its post-cap if pressure correction is exactly zero; otherwise applies original acceleration and total-speed caps.

threshold.rule: max(occupancy-weightedQ75 historical grid density, occupancy-weightedQ99 isolated-agent density at same historical positions)
threshold.weights: Node occupancy; same Stadium operational selection rule, recomputed in MOT U with h=.6U
threshold.scope: All available GT footpoints in 50 strictly historical frames, not future-scored subset
threshold.freeze: Write independent calibration and source hashes before any rollout/error score; no outcome-based adjustment
threshold.positiveExcess: Verify at least some historical grid nodes exceed rho0 before rollout

activation.definition: Stage1 actual after-cap pressure increments greater than1e-12 divided by all agent-substeps
activation.failurePolicy: Retain and report any window below 5%; this is an unmet activation target, separate from numerical validity. Do not retune the final parameters.

metrics.primary: Per-person mean4s ADE and final FDE in provisional U; equal-window aggregate primary, person-window-weighted secondary
metrics.pixels: Backproject predictions through the saved U-to-anchor homography and per-frame anchor-to-image registration; evaluate MOT GT bounding-box footpoint error in original pixels
metrics.cohort: Identical original complete51historical+100future GT trajectories across all four methods; all initial agents simulated, including unscored ones
metrics.uncertainty: Four windows share one sequence and potentially identities; no independent-person tests, no ten-seedCI, no claim of multi-scene generalization

units: U is per-window normalized author-estimated ground length; 1U=median complete-history OLS speed times1s. U is neither camera mouth width W nor measured metres. Same force/threshold rule does not imply matched physical scale.
limitations: Short closed-cohort trajectory auxiliary check, not macro flow validation. GT annotations are human labels but projection and camera calibration remain provisional. No future arrivals, future goals or state resets.
